title: Tiny, cute roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0457b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sole' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e6a817'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- boot body -->
  <path d='M28,32 Q24,30 24,38 L24,60 Q24,66 30,66 L68,66 Q76,66 76,58 L76,50 Q76,44 70,42 L58,38 Q52,36 48,36 L32,36 Q28,36 28,32 Z' fill='url(#boot)'/>
  <!-- boot ankle collar -->
  <path d='M26,36 Q24,28 32,26 L44,26 Q52,26 52,32 Q52,36 46,36 L34,36 Q28,36 26,36 Z' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <!-- toe highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='54' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ff8fb3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- laces -->
  <line x1='36' y1='40' x2='48' y2='44' stroke='#fff4e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='46' x2='50' y2='49' stroke='#fff4e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='52' x2='52' y2='54' stroke='#fff4e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lace bow -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <!-- sole -->
  <rect x='22' y='64' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='url(#sole)'/>
  <!-- sole highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='65' width='50' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe599' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- toe stop -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='68' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='68' r='3' fill='#ffe599'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='7' fill='#5eead4'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='4' fill='#a7f3d0'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#0d9488'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='76' r='7' fill='#5eead4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='76' r='4' fill='#a7f3d0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#0d9488'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M82,30 L83,34 L87,35 L83,36 L82,40 L81,36 L77,35 L81,34 Z' fill='#ffe599'/>
  <path d='M16,42 L16.8,45 L20,45.8 L16.8,46.6 L16,50 L15.2,46.6 L12,45.8 L15.2,45 Z' fill='#a7f3d0'/>
</svg>
